<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import deque
lines=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
rows=len(lines); cols=max(len(l) for l in lines)
def cell(r,c):
    if r<0 or r>=rows or c<0 or c>=cols: return 'B'
    return lines[r][c] if c<len(lines[r]) else 'B'
def passable(r,c): return cell(r,c) not in ('B','M')
def box_ok(r,c): return all(passable(r+i,c+j) for i in range(3) for j in range(3))

start=(15,15); goal=(45,45)
D={'UP':(-1,0),'DOWN':(1,0),'LEFT':(0,-1),'RIGHT':(0,1)}
q=deque([start]); prev={start:None}
while q:
    p=q.popleft()
    if p==goal: break
    for name,(dr,dc) in D.items():
        np=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)
        if box_ok(*np) and np not in prev:
            prev[np]=p; q.append(np)
assert goal in prev, "no path"
# trace back: move name = direction from parent to child
path=[]; cur=goal
while prev[cur] is not None:
    pr,pc=prev[cur]; cr,cc=cur
    d='DOWN' if pr<cr else 'UP' if pr>cr else 'RIGHT' if pc<cc else 'LEFT'
    path.append(d); cur=(pr,pc)
path.reverse()
# verify by simulation
r,c=start
for i,d in enumerate(path):
    dr,dc=D[d]; r+=dr; c+=dc
    assert box_ok(r,c), (i,d,r,c)
assert (r,c)==goal
print("verified path len:", len(path))
print(path)
result=path
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
